title: Have / Get + Something + V3
titleEn: Using Have / Get + object + past participle for arranged services

source.file: Sentence Structure 171 -「Have _ Get + Something + V3」使役句.pdf
omissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules are faithful editorial translations.

formula: Subject + have / get (appropriate tense) + object + past participle + other information

formulas.formula: Subject + have / get (appropriate tense) + object + past participle + other information

example: I had my laptop repaired yesterday.
exampleZh: 我昨天找人修理了手提電腦。

examples.en: I had my laptop repaired yesterday.
examples.zh: 我昨天找人修理了手提電腦。
examples.highlight: I had my laptop repaired yesterday.

rules.zh: 主語通常不是執行動作的人 ＝我親自修理手提電腦。 ＝我安排別人修理手提電腦。
rules.en: The subject is normally not the person who performs the action. I repaired my laptop means that I did the repair myself; I had my laptop repaired means that I arranged for someone else to repair it.

rules.zh: 時態放在 have 或 get 上 Present 現在式 Past 過去式 Present Continuous 現在進行式 Future 將來式 Modal Verb 情態動詞
rules.en: Mark the tense on have or get. Use have/get for the present, had/got for the past, am having/am getting for the present continuous, will have/will get for the future, and forms such as should have/should get after a modal.
examples: I have my car serviced every year.
I get my car serviced every year.
I had my car serviced yesterday.
I got my car serviced yesterday.
I am having my car serviced now.
I am getting my car serviced now.
I will have my car serviced tomorrow.
I will get my car serviced tomorrow.
You should have your eyes tested.
You should get your eyes tested.

rules.zh: 動詞必須使用過去分詞 V3
rules.en: The service verb must be a past participle (V3), including regular forms such as repaired, checked and installed and irregular forms such as cut, taken, written, made and sent.

rules.zh: 物件放在 have／get 和過去分詞之間 第二句通常表示「我已經親自修理了手提電腦」，意思不同。
rules.en: Place the object between have/get and the past participle: I had my laptop repaired. I had repaired my laptop normally means that I personally completed the repair, so its meaning is different.

rules.zh: Have 和 get 的分別 Have something done 語氣較中性，適合日常及正式場合。 Get something done 較常用於日常會話，語氣通常較口語。 在大部分句子中，兩者都可以使用： 本練習的參考答案會交替使用 have 和 get。只要時態正確並保留原意，另一種形式通常也可以 接受。
rules.en: Have something done is neutral and suits both everyday and formal contexts. Get something done is more common in everyday conversation and usually sounds more informal. In most sentences both are possible, as in I had/got my hair cut. The model answers alternate between have and get; the other form is normally acceptable if the tense and meaning are preserved.

rules.zh: 可以加入執行動作的人 （我請技術員修理了手提電腦。） 如執行者並不重要，可以省略 by + person：
rules.en: You may add the person who performs the action with by: I had my laptop repaired by a technician. If the performer is unimportant, omit the by-phrase: I had my laptop repaired.
examples: I had my laptop repaired by a technician.

rules.zh: 本課不包括意外或不幸經歷 （我的銀包被偷了。） 這裏並不是說話者安排別人偷銀包，因此不屬於本課重點。本課主要練習安排服務或請別人完成 工作。
rules.en: This lesson does not cover accidental or unfortunate experiences such as I had my wallet stolen. That sentence does not mean the speaker arranged the theft. The lesson focuses on arranging a service or asking someone to complete work.

benefits.zh: 清楚表示「找別人處理」 這個句型可以清楚區分你是親自做某件事，還是安排專業人士替你處理。 表示我親自替自己剪頭髮。 表示我請髮型師替我剪頭髮。
benefits.en: It clearly distinguishes doing something yourself from arranging for a professional or another person to do it. I cut my hair means that I did it myself; I had my hair cut means that I arranged for a hairdresser to do it.

benefits.zh: 把較長的解釋縮短 你不需要每次都使用較長的說法，例如： 你可以更簡潔地說：
benefits.en: It shortens a longer explanation. Instead of I asked a technician to repair my laptop, you can say more concisely, I had my laptop repaired.
examples: I asked a technician to repair my laptop.

benefits.zh: 把重點放在服務或結果上 有時候，替你完成工作的人並不重要。你只需要說明事情已經處理好。 句子的重點是辦公室已經清潔，而不是哪一位清潔員完成工作。
benefits.en: It places the emphasis on the service or completed result when the person who did the work is unimportant. We had the office cleaned focuses on the fact that the office was cleaned, not on which cleaner did it.

benefits.zh: 適合很多日常生活情境 這個句型經常用於以下情況： 剪頭髮、驗眼、洗牙、修理電器、維修汽車、送貨、印刷文件、清潔房屋、安裝設備及翻譯文件。 掌握這個句型後，你可以更自然地談論自己使用過或準備使用的服務。
benefits.en: It applies naturally to many everyday services, including haircuts, eye tests, dental cleaning, appliance and car repairs, delivery, printing, house cleaning, equipment installation and document translation. Once you know the pattern, you can speak more naturally about services you have used or plan to use.

benefits.zh: 可以靈活配合不同時態 你可以用這個句型談論過去、現在、將來、計劃、建議和問題：
benefits.en: It works flexibly with past, present and future tenses, plans, advice and questions.
examples: I had my phone repaired yesterday.
I am having my phone repaired now.
I will have my phone repaired tomorrow.
You should get your phone repaired.
Did you have your phone repaired?

benefits.zh: 令說話和寫作更加自然 英語使用者通常不會把每項服務都說成： 使用 have/get something done 可以避免重複，令表達更簡潔和自然。
benefits.en: It makes speaking and writing more concise and natural by avoiding repeated phrases such as I asked someone to or someone did something for me.
